title: CC Reminder signed helper manifest
description: Authoritative record of every packaged helper binary. The desktop app embeds this manifest and, at runtime, selects the entry whose target_triple matches the current compile target. The helper bytes are SHA-256 + length verified against the selected entry BEFORE the stable per-user copy is touched. A manifest path or checksum is NEVER accepted from runtime configuration (design 9.1). The placeholder version below is the documented shape; release packaging replaces the helpers array with one real entry per target triple (compiled cc-reminder-hook binary, real length, real SHA-256). Until release tooling generates real values, the runtime installer consumes an already-selected HelperManifestEntry plus its bytes (see src/installer/helper.rs), so the security-critical verify-then-copy path is exercised exactly as shipped by the unit tests.
